newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Late selling drags down Manila index at close.
newsitem.headline: Late selling drags down Manila index at close.

text.p: * Main index falls through support at 3,374 pts
Late selling on blue-chips along with thirdliners sent the Manila composite index falling to 3,358.70 points at the close, down 27.32 points or 0.81 percent, traders said.

"Some of the blue-chips were weaker in late trade. Some traders caught up in thirdliners which shed points may have opted to sell their blue-chips as well," said Joey Roxas, president of brokerage Eagle Securities.
The index was trading in a narrow band early in the session in thin volume with attention mostly on thirdliners.
But in late trade, profit-taking on these tertiary issues ensued and blue-chips San Miguel Corp B, Ayala Land Inc and Philippine National Bank were also sold in substantial volumes.
San Miguel B closed a peso down at 101 pesos while PNB was down 2.50 pesos at 325. Ayala Land ended unchanged at 32 pesos.
Value turnover was heavier at 3.376 billion pesos. All sectors fell with decliners outnumbering advancers 99 to 40. There were 60 unchanged issues.
The support level of 3,374 points was broken at the session's finish, traders said.

"I think some people are also unloading blue-chips in preparation for Equitable Bank's initial public offering," said Jonas Ferrer, research director at Pryce Securities Inc. Equitable has started a roadshow to drum up support for its IPO.
Ferrer said the market's liquidity should improve on Wednesday as most foreign fund managers would have come back from the Chinese lunar New Year holiday celebrationS.
